clientId.description: The exact registered OAuth client identity, including the metadata URL for a client registered through client metadata discovery.

connectionKey.description: The stable Key of the Connected Apps connection.

sessionKey.description: The Key of the token family used by this request.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: The expiry of the access token supplied with this request.

scopes.description: The scopes granted to the access token supplied with this request.

resource.description: The protected resource authorized by the access token supplied with this request.

displayName.description: The Personal Access Token name or OAuth application name.

description: Non-secret metadata about the OAuth access token supplied with the request and its connection and session.
